svg.title: Traces workbench
svg.desc: Pulsus Dash Traces workbench for payments to psp-api client spans: TraceQL editor, RED summary tiles vs −7d, a span duration by time scatter with a density field and outliers showing failed spans pinned at exactly 2.000 s after the 12:19 timeout change, a brushed trace list with selection-vs-baseline compare, and the waterfall of trace 4bf92f35 where the psp-api client span times out while the remote psp-api span completes in 2.3 s.

g.text: duration (log) × time · 1.84M client spans · density + outliers · status by colour and shape
Unchanged keys listed so nobody re-checks pods, version or region.
remote span 2.30 s · 200 OK, after the client gave up
Failed spans sit on a flat line at exactly
2.000 s: the signature of a client timeout.
p95 looks better than −7d because the
timeout caps it; read it with errors.
psp-api still answers in 2.3 s, as usual:
it is unchanged; we got stricter.
error spans get ✖ and a red edge.
